# Browser Foundation Checklist: Playwright End-to-End Testing Foundation

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, measurability, and consistency of the
Playwright foundation requirements before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based
on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review
artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality
criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for
requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the responsibilities of the shared runner, the initial smoke journey, and future feature-owned journeys explicitly separated? [Completeness, Spec §Technical Boundaries]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the supported browser target and deferred browser targets explicitly identified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK003 Are dependency installation, browser binary installation, and local execution prerequisites all documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the normal local-server workflow and the already-running-server workflow both defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Acceptance Scenario 1.2]
- [ ] CHK005 Are browser dependency installation, cache location, and local execution prerequisites covered as separate requirement concerns? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK006 Are tracked-source boundaries for binaries, reports, traces, screenshots, videos, and profiles explicitly stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, §SC-006]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the documented browser-test command named precisely enough for a maintainer to run it from the repository root? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK008 Is “basic usability” of the initial smoke journey defined by observable application signals rather than a vague visual impression? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the endpoint default, override mechanism, and unavailable-endpoint behavior unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Is “clean browser context” distinguished from a persistent profile, saved storage state, and application persistence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK011 Is “useful failure evidence” defined for navigation, rendering, interaction, and assertion failures? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006–FR-007, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the browser binary cache location and tracked-source boundary explicit enough for maintainers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Are the local-only and no-third-party-service constraints consistent with the server-startup and base-URL requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-011, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the failure-evidence retention rules consistent with the requirement to avoid unnecessary artifacts on passing runs? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Acceptance Scenario 2.3]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the initial Chromium-only boundary and future cross-browser extension boundary consistent across requirements, assumptions, and technical boundaries? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §Technical Boundaries]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the server-startup and already-running-endpoint requirements consistent across the runner configuration and quickstart? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Acceptance Scenario 1.2]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 Can the fresh-checkout smoke command outcome be objectively classified as pass, startup failure, or test failure? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK018 Can context isolation be evaluated independently for every initial smoke journey? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK019 Can a controlled assertion failure be mapped to a scenario name and assertion from command output or a generated report? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK020 Can the absence of tracked browser artifacts be evaluated from repository state after a run? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are primary success, existing-server alternate, startup exception, and failed-journey evidence scenarios all represented? [Coverage, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Are repeated-run and different-worker scenarios defined as determinism concerns rather than dependent on one execution order? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004–FR-005, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK023 Are future feature journeys explicitly required to own their setup, assertions, and failure identification? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK024 Are semantic and keyboard-oriented interaction expectations connected to future journey requirements without forcing business behavior into the smoke test? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, §Technical Boundaries]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 Are server startup failure, unavailable endpoint, and navigation failure requirements distinct enough to produce actionable diagnosis? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the no-network-to-third-party constraint explicit for both the runner and the initial smoke journey? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Are empty in-memory application state and the absence of persistent browser state addressed for future tests? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 Is browser installation behavior defined for a fresh checkout and for a machine with an existing browser cache? [Edge Case, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-012]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK029 Are WCAG AA and AXE compatibility requirements scoped clearly enough to distinguish the shared foundation from feature-owned accessibility assertions? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-008, §Technical Boundaries]
- [ ] CHK030 Are privacy and local-first constraints explicit about browser profiles, persistence, external services, and diagnostic output? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-011, Constitution Principle IV]
- [ ] CHK031 Are the reproducibility expectations explicit about browser version, test context, execution order, and worker configuration? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-004–FR-005, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK032 Are generated artifacts and browser binaries excluded from the tracked source boundary without making failure diagnosis impossible? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-007, §FR-012]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK033 Are the Playwright Test dependency and the separately installed Playwright CLI clearly distinguished? [Dependency, Spec §FR-009, §FR-014, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the assumption that maintainers can access the Playwright CLI documented with a reproducible installation path? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK035 Are the existing Angular unit-test responsibilities and the new browser-test responsibilities clearly non-overlapping? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- This checklist evaluates the written requirements, not whether the Playwright implementation works.
